{"task":{"id":"Prob104_mt2015_muxdff","spec":"
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  L
 - input  q_in
 - input  r_in
 - output Q

Consider this Verilog module "full_module":

  module full_module (
      input [2:0] r,
      input L,
      input clk,
      output reg [2:0] q);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
      if (L) begin
        q <= r;
      end else begin
        q <= {q[1] ^ q[2], q[0], q[2]};
      end
    end

  endmodule

Note that q[2:0] is three bits wide, representing three flip-flops that can be
loaded from r when L is asserted. You want to factor full_module into a hierarchical
design, flipflop and 2:1 multiplexer are in a submodule "TopModule", and that submodule
will be instantiated three times in full_module code. Create the submodule called "TopModule".
You do not have to provide the revised full_module.

Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI."},"current":{"revision_id":"f5932cad-bffa-46f7-9ac4-ca7834a9559d","source_sha256":"87d6358b4b4358dbfe895fa5493fab1772fa04f8877c1d756f738264d322d1da","source":"module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic L,
    input  logic q_in,
    input  logic r_in,
    output logic Q
);

    // 2:1 multiplexer: load r_in when L is high, otherwise take q_in
    logic d;
    assign d = L ? r_in : q_in;

    // D flip-flop with defined power-up value
    initial Q = 1'b0;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        Q <= d;
    end

endmodule
